messages:
jamal-eng: Hey people-ops — planning to work remotely from my partner's family home in Athens for ~10 weeks (mid-May → end of July). Quick Qs: will my WFH stipend be prorated for the 10-week period? Do I need to declare a temporary homebase? Any payroll/tax nexus risk for ~70 days? Also need to ship my work laptop there — anything I should do re: insurance/approval? :airplane:

sasha-peopleops: Thanks Jamal. Short answers: 1) Stipend: we prorate for multi-week moves. 10 weeks will be prorated (we'll calculate based on monthly allowance). 2) Homebase: yes — submit the Temporary Location form so we have dates + address in payroll. 3) Tax/nexus: 70 days is borderline; Greece rules don’t trigger residency until ~183 days, but there are local employer obligations that can surface earlier. We'll run a quick nexus check with payroll before you leave. 4) Laptop: please do NOT ship without approval — we use our vendor or approved courier, and you need export paperwork if leaving EU/non-EU.

sasha-peopleops: Quick checklist (please fill & attach where applicable):
```
- Temporary Location form (name, start_date, end_date, full address, manager approval)
- Reason for travel (personal/family)
- Laptop shipping request (yes/no) + preferred vendor
- Confirmation you'll remain on Redwood payroll and not contract with local orgs
```

garret-payroll: tagging in — Jamal, can you share exact start/end dates? Also confirm whether you'll be paid in USD or need local bank routing. For Greece: no automatic payroll cutover for 70d, but social security rules and permanent establishment risk depend on activity. We'll run a quick risk calc if you give dates. If laptop crosses customs, we may need temporary export docs.

maya-manager: maya-manager here — I approve this in principle. Jamal, please fill the form and CC me. I don't expect any product coverage gaps but confirm your on-call windows if anything shifts.

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-4589 — "Temporary remote: Athens 2026-05-15 to 2026-07-31". This will track approvals and payroll checks.

sasha-peopleops: Shipping note: our preferred vendor is GlobalShip (contact: ops-ship@redwood.com). If you want personal courier, we will not cover customs/insurance — vendor quotes are on the shipping policy doc: https://redwood.company/hr/shipping-policy. If company vendor used, we insure company-owned device up to $2k for international transit.

garret-payroll: Also, reminder: if your itinerary extends past 90 days, ping payroll immediately. We also need to know if you'll work for any local clients or contractors while there — that changes everything.

jamal-eng: Thanks all — I'll fill the Temporary Location form today with exact dates and vendor preference. Will CC maya and ping garret after I submit. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
